name: Checkbox
description: A check box that floods with water when turned on, with groups, an indeterminate state and a card variant.

props.name: children
props.description: The label, to the right of the box.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the label.

props.name: size
props.description: Box of 16 or 18 pixels. Inside a group, defaults to the group's size.

props.name: isSelected
props.description: Checked state (controlled). Use defaultSelected when uncontrolled.

props.name: isIndeterminate
props.description: Shows a dash, for a parent whose children are partly checked.

props.name: value
props.description: The value this checkbox adds to its group.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the checked state changes.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the checkbox and dims it to 50%.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Gives the empty box a camellia outline.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components CheckboxField.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the group.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the group.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown under the group while it is invalid.

props.name: size
props.description: Size for every checkbox and card in the group.

props.name: value
props.description: Checked values (controlled). Use defaultValue when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the checked values change.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components CheckboxGroup.

props.name: children
props.description: The title.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the title.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the box on the right.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the card. Accepts the same props as Checkbox.
